Smoke test: load astro and parse a simple snippet

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\TreeSitterLanguagePack;
use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\Language;
use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\ProcessConfig;
use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\Tree;
$config = \Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\ProcessConfig::from_json(json_encode(["language" => "astro"]));
$result = TreeSitterLanguagePack::process("---\n---\n<p>hello</p>", $config);
var_dump($result);
```
